violation_type.title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Enrolled in Approved Child-care Career Program (26 TAC §744.1107(b)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Caregiver Qualification Age Exemption Attends High School - Enrolled in Approved Child-care Career Program
violation_type.typical_finding: 1 of 5 employees, who is 17 years old, does not have proof of being enrolled in a program allowing her to be eligible to work in a licensed facility.

finding_variants.text: 1 of 5 employees, who is 17 years old, does not have proof of being enrolled in a program allowing her to be eligible to work in a licensed facility.
Two out of two unqualified caregivers did not have a child care related career program available for review during the visit.
A highschool student who is not enrolled in an approved Child Care Career Program was observed supervising children at the operation.
A caregiver who attends high school is not enrolled in an approved childcare career program.
The operation did not have information available indicating whether or not a 17 year old caregiver is currently enrolled in or has completed a child-care-related career program.
A caregiver who is attending high school does not have proof of being enrolled into program.
